name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) hard matches 'take the key, then open the door'. Existence(door_open) hard is required because its only later step, the box pickup, is soft and forces nothing, so the door is a lone commanded step. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard keeps the 'after that' order, since the 'try to' cue scopes only the box pickup. Existence(target_picked_up) soft matches 'try to pick up the box'. There is no Existence on has_door_key, which the hard chain forces, and no clause goes beyond the task.

texts: The agent must take the matching key before the door is opened.
Picking up the box in the other room must come after the door has been opened.
Picking up the box in the other room is preferred but not required.
